quarantined_patch.quarantine_reason: It correctly removed the silent 42/2 fallback and range-validated +lat_0/+lon_0, but it REJECTED any geoReference lacking both origin parameters. The authoritative map of record (SHA256 370ABBBB...) declares only '+proj=tmerc', so this patch would have made the authoritative Ingolstadt map fail to parse and fail to load.

preserved_ideas_carried_forward: partial origin (exactly one of the pair) rejected as inconsistent
reject rather than clamp out-of-range values
ideas_deliberately_not_carried_forward: rejecting a projection that carries no origin parameters -- that is the legitimate local-frame case (bare +proj=tmerc, UTM, empty)
